project.name: GEODE
project.description: Source-attested promotion path from a bounded policy mutation to paired tau2 evidence.

nodes.name: Tau2 agent policy
nodes.summary: The sole candidate-owned behavior surface for this campaign.

nodes.name: Tau2 GEODE adapter
nodes.summary: Builds GEODE participants on one process-owned hook and middleware runtime, delegates half-duplex turn control, and binds native results before session closure.

nodes.name: Tau2 runtime contract
nodes.summary: Owns shared hooks and middleware, captures the effective runtime profile, records retry lineage, and joins exact native Tau2 verdicts before session closure.

nodes.name: Benchmark trajectory artifact bridge
nodes.summary: Projects benchmark-native receipts into schema-validated GEODE trajectories outside the Crucible candidate mutation surface.

nodes.name: Tau2 turn supervisor
nodes.summary: Owns the half-duplex deadline, stop mapping, and exact ToolCall.id to ToolMessage.id result join while AgenticLoop yields after deferred external tool batches.

nodes.name: AgenticLoop
nodes.summary: Runs model and tool rounds until termination, with default-off external boundaries and current-run pre-execution retry identity for evaluator attestation.

nodes.name: Tool call processor
nodes.summary: Executes one model response's tool calls, preserves input order, and leaves deferred external acknowledgements open until their native result is joined.

nodes.name: Paired tau2 evaluator
nodes.summary: Derives frozen runner arguments, gives baseline and candidate one supervisor-anchored shared deadline, and emits receipts bound to exact arm artifacts. Screens unreachable train arms at zero candidate cost, disables legacy row reuse that lacks snapshot-v4 companions, projects structural failure codes, and stops the paid process group after finalized infrastructure contamination.

nodes.name: Runtime receipt
nodes.summary: Binds supervisor-anchored shared-deadline arm allocations, cache provenance, exact evidence and raw artifact identities, right-censoring, measured cleanup, and explicitly unmeasured outer scopes to the experiment runtime regime.

nodes.name: Promotion supervisor
nodes.summary: Preflights authority inputs, binds optional producer objectives, anchors the evaluator to an absolute live deadline with fixed finalization grace, validates artifact-bound runtime receipts, rejects duplicate baseline-bound treatments, reaps role process groups, and owns the monotone search ref.

nodes.name: Evaluator entrypoint
nodes.summary: Selects the locked runtime and invokes the trusted paired evaluator outside the candidate surface.

nodes.name: Codex KG producer
nodes.summary: Gives GPT-5.4 a bounded one-hop architecture subgraph plus bound objective and closed failure codes, hides supervisor protocol paths, and emits bounded structured failures.

nodes.name: Crucible program
nodes.summary: Centralizes experimentation, constraints, preferences, setup, power and runtime admission, artifact-bound runtime evidence, deduplication, infrastructure-safe checkpoint reuse, usage accounting, and the closed dynamic-feedback boundary; only its candidate_program section is model-facing.

nodes.name: Candidate replay producer
nodes.summary: Reuses the exact candidate revision after scoreless infrastructure invalidation, rebases only across evaluator revisions, and preserves bounded structured producer failures.
